author: Athul Prem
research_question: Measure the frequency variation of the saved same-symmetry 1 GHz reflected-conversion pair at one accepted five-channel sample, 0.8875 GHz, on the exact archived h80 z6 device.
observable: All five per-drive R/T and converted powers, all 50 propagating complex coefficients at original planes, and both field-matched directed reflected-conversion powers.

scope.stop_condition: One accepted new point plus independent replay and saved-anchor comparison, or a retained failure without automatic retry, offset frequency, resource escalation or campaign.

signed_relation.author: Athul Prem

matching_method.one_to_one_assignment: Maximum sum of normalized mass overlaps within each signed group.
matching_method.gauge: candidate aligned coefficient = outgoing overlap phase * raw coefficient / incoming overlap phase

signed_relation.scope: Two finite frequencies on the saved h80/z6 device, at original 0/16.65 micrometre end planes. Frequency differences are physical response variation in this discretized model, not a mesh-convergence test, numerical uncertainty bound, conversion mechanism or continuous-branch proof. All previous failed 1 GHz spatial comparisons remain failed; spatial and frequency convergence remain unresolved.
